smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-sort TopLevelDeclarations) (declare-const mk-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)
(declare-sort Planet) (declare-const mk-Planet Planet)
(declare-sort Earth) (declare-const mk-Earth Earth)
(declare-sort Mars) (declare-const mk-Mars Mars)
(declare-datatypes () ((Spacecraft (mk-Spacecraft (cost Real)(destination Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((LowCostSCFleet (mk-LowCostSCFleet (deployedSC (Set Ref))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((FeasibleLowCostSCFleet (mk-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet (deployedSC (Set Ref))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Planet (sel-Planet Planet))
  (lift-Earth (sel-Earth Earth))
  (lift-Mars (sel-Mars Mars))
  (lift-Spacecraft (sel-Spacecraft Spacecraft))
  (lift-LowCostSCFleet (sel-LowCostSCFleet LowCostSCFleet))
  (lift-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet (sel-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet FeasibleLowCostSCFleet))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Planet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Planet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Planet ((this Ref)) Planet
  (sel-Planet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Earth ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Earth (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Earth ((this Ref)) Earth
  (sel-Earth (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Mars ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Mars (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Mars ((this Ref)) Mars
  (sel-Mars (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Spacecraft ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Spacecraft (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Spacecraft ((this Ref)) Spacecraft
  (sel-Spacecraft (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-LowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-LowCostSCFleet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-LowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) LowCostSCFleet
  (sel-LowCostSCFleet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) FeasibleLowCostSCFleet
  (sel-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Planet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Planet this)
    (deref-is-Earth this)
    (deref-is-Mars this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Earth ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Earth this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Mars ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Mars this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Spacecraft ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Spacecraft this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-LowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-LowCostSCFleet this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class Spacecraft:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for Spacecraft.cost: ---

(define-fun Spacecraft.cost ((this Ref)) Real
  (cost (deref-Spacecraft this))
)

; --- getters for Spacecraft.destination: ---

(define-fun Spacecraft.destination ((this Ref)) Ref
  (destination (deref-Spacecraft this))
)

(define-fun Spacecraft!destination ((this Ref)) Ref
  (destination (deref-Spacecraft this))
)

; -------------------------------------
;   Getters for class LowCostSCFleet:
; -------------------------------------

; --- getters for LowCostSCFleet.deployedSC: ---

(define-fun LowCostSCFleet!deployedSC ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (deployedSC (deref-LowCostSCFleet this))
)

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class FeasibleLowCostSCFleet:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- getters for FeasibleLowCostSCFleet.deployedSC: ---

(define-fun FeasibleLowCostSCFleet!deployedSC ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (deployedSC (deref-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Planet:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-Planet Planet)
(declare-const const-6-Planet Planet)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Earth:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Earth Earth)



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Mars:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-Mars Mars)



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Spacecraft:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-7-Spacecraft Spacecraft)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Spacecraft.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Planet (Spacecraft!destination this))
)

(assert (! (Spacecraft.inv1 7) :named _xkassert253))



; ---------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class LowCostSCFleet:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-LowCostSCFleet LowCostSCFleet)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun LowCostSCFleet.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((sc Ref)) (=> (select (LowCostSCFleet!deployedSC this) sc) (< (Spacecraft.cost sc) 1000000.0000000000000000)))
)

(assert (! (LowCostSCFleet.inv1 1) :named _xkassert254))



; -----------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class FeasibleLowCostSCFleet:
; -----------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet FeasibleLowCostSCFleet)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun FeasibleLowCostSCFleet.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (FeasibleLowCostSCFleet!deployedSC this) ((as const (Set Int)) false)))
)

(assert (! (FeasibleLowCostSCFleet.inv1 2) :named _xkassert255))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun FeasibleLowCostSCFleet.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((sc Ref)) (=> (select (FeasibleLowCostSCFleet!deployedSC this) sc) (deref-isa-Earth (Spacecraft.destination sc))))
)

(assert (! (FeasibleLowCostSCFleet.inv2 2) :named _xkassert256))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        5 (lift-Planet const-5-Planet))
        6 (lift-Planet const-6-Planet))
        3 (lift-Earth const-3-Earth))
        4 (lift-Mars const-4-Mars))
        7 (lift-Spacecraft const-7-Spacecraft))
        1 (lift-LowCostSCFleet const-1-LowCostSCFleet))
        2 (lift-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet const-2-FeasibleLowCostSCFleet))
  )
)
